description: The ⌘K command palette — a keyboard-driven launcher for search + navigation + actions, matching the Paper design (VC-1). It IS the shell's Search field (⌘K) upgraded from a filter to a full palette. Near-1:1 Astryx port: built on the Astryx CommandPalette component (import from '@astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette') + the useHotkeys hook. Reuses v1's data (projects/threads via /api/agent/projects) and the v2 activeThread nav (from p2a) through ui/src/v2/lib adapters; gateway + v1 UNCHANGED. Ties into search + navigation; DEPENDS ON p2a (activeThread) and reads best with p2d's real project/thread data (degrade gracefully to static + the data that exists). READ docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §10 BEFORE any story.

designFile.node: VC-1 — the command palette (search input + result list [Home · Settings · Profile · Dashboard · Help] + footer hints ↑↓ Navigate · ↵ Select · Esc Close)
designFile.note: The Astryx CommandPalette provides the input/list/footer structure and keyboard behavior — configure it, don't pixel-rebuild. Match VC-1 for the dark palette + Figtree via tokens; pull any exact value with get_computed_styles on the VC-1 subtree, never a screenshot. The sidebar Search field (shell node MU-0/RV-0) is the OPENER, not a separate search.

conventions.astryxComponent: Build on Astryx CommandPalette (import from '@astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette'): props isOpen/onOpenChange (required), searchSource (required — SearchSource<T> with search(query)+bootstrap(); use createStaticSource for static lists), input=<CommandPaletteInput/>, footer=<CommandPaletteFooter/> (keyboard hints), renderItem, auxiliaryData.group for grouped sections, width 640/maxHeight 480. ⌘K via the useHotkeys hook (`npx astryx hook useHotkeys`). Study `npx astryx template CommandPaletteAutoGrouped` / `CommandPaletteAsyncSearch`. Confirm every prop with `npx astryx component CommandPalette --json`.
conventions.reuseData: SearchSource pulls from v1's existing data via ui/src/v2/lib adapters — projects/threads from GET /api/agent/projects; selecting a thread sets the v2 activeThread (from p2a). Do NOT modify src/ or v1.
conventions.astryxOnly: Astryx + ui/src/v2/tokens.css only. No shadcn/Radix, no Tailwind, no raw <div>/hex/px.
conventions.v1Untouched: v1 renders pixel-unchanged with the flag OFF.
conventions.gatewayRule: Never run a human's :3747/:5173 from an agent session. Throwaway ports only; verify with automate-browser (VITE_CONAN_V2=1).

userStories.title: Command palette shell + ⌘K hotkey
userStories.description: As a user, I want to press ⌘K (or click the sidebar Search) to open a command palette with a search input, a result list, and keyboard hints, so I have one keyboard-driven launcher.
acceptanceCriteria: New ui/src/v2/command/CommandPalette.tsx wraps Astryx CommandPalette with isOpen/onOpenChange state; opens on ⌘K (Astryx useHotkeys) AND on clicking the sidebar Search field (MU-0); Esc closes

Uses the default CommandPaletteInput + CommandPaletteFooter (↑↓ Navigate · ↵ Select · Esc Close), a bootstrap() of a few static items so the palette is useful before typing (match VC-1's list as placeholders), width 640
Mounted once at the App.v2 level (not per-pane); Astryx + tokens only; matches VC-1 (dark, Figtree) — verify with get_computed_styles
Owns ui/src/v2/command/CommandPalette.tsx (+ test) and the ⌘K wiring in App.v2.tsx; v1 untouched; typecheck + build + vitest pass; verify open/close + keyboard nav on a throwaway stack
userStories.notes: Foundation. Astryx: CommandPalette https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/CommandPalette + useHotkeys (`npx astryx hook useHotkeys`); study `npx astryx template CommandPaletteAutoGrouped`. Design: VC-1. Read docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §10. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Search source — threads & projects, grouped, navigable
userStories.description: As a user, I want typing in the palette to filter my projects and threads, and selecting one to jump to it, so the palette is real navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: A SearchSource (ui/src/v2/lib) whose search(query)/bootstrap() return projects + threads from GET /api/agent/projects, grouped via auxiliaryData.group ('Threads', 'Projects'); recent threads show on bootstrap (before typing)
Selecting a thread sets the v2 activeThread (p2a) and closes the palette; selecting a project focuses/opens it
renderItem shows an icon + title + a muted subtitle (project/last message) consistent with the sidebar rows; Astryx + tokens only

Degrades gracefully if p2d's live data isn't wired yet (use whatever /api/agent/projects returns); owns the search-source file (+ test); v1 untouched; typecheck + build + vitest pass; verify filtering + a navigation on a throwaway stack
userStories.notes: This is the 'ties into search' part. Reuse /api/agent/projects (the sidebar's data). auxiliaryData.group auto-sections results. Depends on US-401 + p2a activeThread. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Commands & actions group
userStories.description: As a user, I want the palette to also offer actions — New chat, Open Settings, Commit & Push, Open a surface — so it's a launcher, not just navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: An 'Actions' group in the SearchSource with commands wired to the shell's real handlers: New chat, Open Settings, and the toolbar actions (Actions/Open/Commit & Push) where they exist in v2; each runs on select and closes the palette
Commands are curated + few (per Astryx guidance — don't overload the palette); grouped under 'Actions'; Astryx + tokens only
Owns the commands definition file (+ test); v1 untouched; typecheck + build + vitest pass; verify a couple actions fire on a throwaway stack
userStories.notes: The 'other things' the palette ties into. Wire only actions that exist in v2 today; stub the rest with a clear TODO. Depends on US-401. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Assemble + verify vs VC-1
userStories.description: As the team, we need the palette assembled (search + actions), matched to VC-1, and proven with keyboard-only flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Palette shows grouped results (Threads/Projects/Actions), bootstrap items before typing, empty states ('No results' / 'Type to search'); layout/type/colors match VC-1 (get_screenshot side-by-side)
Keyboard-only: ⌘K opens, arrows navigate across groups, ↵ selects (navigates or runs), Esc closes; no console errors; a11y (dialog role + labels) intact
Astryx + tokens only; v1 untouched; typecheck + build + full vitest pass; verify the full keyboard flow on a throwaway stack, dark; update docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §10 with the outcome
userStories.notes: Integration story — after US-401..US-403. Design: VC-1. Read docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §10. Suggested skills: automate-browser, audit-ui.
